intent: A gothic forest ballgown: a deep-moss bodice with slim dark sleeves and gill-ruffled wrists, a sickly lichen sash at the waist and a matching lichen tier in a wide mushroom-gill skirt under a toadstool-cap bonnet; from the high camera it reads as a narrow cinched top over a bright-rimmed bell.
reason: Fungal ballgown: a toadstool-cap bonnet with a bone rim over a tiered skirt of lichen-yellow gill ruffles; the only set that reads as fungus and as nothing else in the game from the high camera (second critic 6.83, first; first critic 6.85, first).
first_fix: The bodice and sleeves are a full-width dark block and the skirt is a squat knee-length cake: narrow the sleeves, cinch the waist with a bone or lichen band, and lengthen the tiers to the shins.
